sents.en: I am a/an 身份 from 单位.
sents.zh: 我是……（单位）的一名……
sents.meta: 身份备选: undergraduate 本科生 / postgraduate student 研究生 / member of the Students' Union 学生会成员 / volunteer / regular user of the library 图书馆常客; 单位备选: at your university / in our community
sents.ex: I am a second-year student from the Department of Literature at your university.
sents.exz: 我是贵校文学系的一名大二学生。

sents.en: As a/an 身份, I 相关经历或背景.
sents.zh: 作为……，我曾……（适合建议/投诉/申请）
sents.meta: 经历备选: have organized several charity sales / have used the library for several years / have recently experienced a problem with... / have relevant experience in...
sents.ex: As a member of the Students' Union, I have organized several charity sales and volunteer activities on campus.
sents.exz: 作为学生会成员，我曾在校内组织过多次慈善义卖和志愿活动。

sents.en: The purpose of this letter is to 动词原形 + 目的.
sents.zh: 本信旨在……
sents.meta: 按信型替换: 建议 offer several constructive suggestions on+话题 / 邀请 invite you to+活动 / 推荐 recommend+人或物 to you / 申请 apply for+职位 / 感谢道歉 express my heartfelt gratitude/apology to sb. for sth. / 祝贺 express my congratulations on+成就 / 投诉 make a complaint about+事 / 答复 share some relevant details about... / 辞职 inform you of my decision to resign from+职位
sents.ex: The purpose of this letter is to invite you to serve as a judge for the upcoming English speech contest.
sents.exz: 本信旨在邀请您担任即将举行的英语演讲比赛的评委。

sents.en: I am writing this letter in order to 动词原形 + 目的.
sents.zh: 我写此信意在……
sents.meta: 动词替换同上句
sents.ex: I am writing to offer several suggestions in this regard.
sents.exz: 我写信是想就此提出几点建议。（2007英语一）

sents.en: It has been a long time since we last met. How is it going?
sents.zh: 好长时间没见，你好吗？

sents.en: I hope this letter finds you well.
sents.zh: 展展佳。
sents.ex: I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing to recommend one of my favorite movies, The Pursuit of Happyness, to you.
sents.exz: 希望你一切安好。我写信是想向你推荐我最喜欢的电影之一《当幸福来敲门》。（2011英语一）

sents.en: It was wonderful to hear from you.
sents.zh: 很高兴收到你的来信。

sents.en: Thank you for sharing your experience of... with me.
sents.zh: 感谢你与我分享……的经历。
sents.meta: 另备: I'm glad to know that you are interested in... 很高兴得知你对…感兴趣 / I still remember the wonderful time we spent together. 我仍记得我们一起度过的美好时光

sents.en: The activity will focus on 主题或核心内容.
sents.zh: 本次活动将围绕……展开。
sents.meta: activity 可替换 the event / the program / the lecture; focus on 可替换 center on / be devoted to / feature / be organized around
sents.ex: The activity will focus on traditional Chinese culture.
sents.exz: 本次活动将围绕中国传统文化展开。

sents.en: Scheduled for 时间 in 地点, it will include 具体内容.
sents.zh: 本次活动定于……时间在……地点举行，具体包括……
sents.meta: 地点备选: at the school auditorium 学校礼堂 / in Room 201 / on the playground / at the student center; include 可替换 will feature / will consist of / will cover / will offer
sents.ex: Scheduled for May 10 in the school auditorium, it will include a lecture, a group discussion and a cultural performance.
sents.exz: 本次活动定于5月10日在学校礼堂举行，包括讲座、小组讨论和文化表演。

sents.en: It is scheduled to take place on 日期 at 具体时间 in/at 地点, and will consist of 具体内容.
sents.zh: 活动定于……日……时间在……地点举办，由……环节组成。
sents.meta: 两版选一背
sents.ex: It is scheduled to take place on October 15 at 14:00 in the lecture hall, and will consist of a keynote speech and an interactive Q&A session.
sents.exz: 活动定于10月15日14点在报告厅举办，由主题演讲和互动问答环节组成。

sents.en: Participants will also have the opportunity to 具体活动或收获.
sents.zh: 参加者还将有机会……
sents.meta: 收获备选: exchange ideas with 与…交流 / learn more about / gain a better understanding of / develop their skills in / broaden their horizons 拓宽视野 / enrich their practical experience / make friends with like-minded peers / acquire professional knowledge
sents.ex: Participants will also have the opportunity to exchange ideas with students from different countries.
sents.exz: 参加者还将有机会与来自不同国家的学生交流观点。

sents.en: This experience will also enable all participants to 具体活动或收获.
sents.zh: 这段经历也将使所有参与者能够……
sents.ex: This experience will also enable all participants to develop their practical skills in cross-cultural communication.
sents.exz: 这段经历也将使所有参与者培养跨文化交流的实践能力。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 讲事情补充
sents.en: Your support with 具体事项 was particularly valuable.
sents.zh: 您在……方面给予的支持尤其宝贵。
sents.meta: 事项备选: my studies / my application / organizing the event / solving the problem; support with 可替换 help with / assistance with
sents.ex: Your support with my studies was particularly valuable.
sents.exz: 您在我学习方面给予的支持尤其宝贵。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 讲事情补充
sents.en: Your success in 具体事项 was particularly impressive.
sents.zh: 您在……方面取得的成功尤其令人钦佩。
sents.meta: 事项备选: the competition / your academic studies / completing the project / receiving the scholarship / gaining admission to your ideal university
sents.ex: Your success in the competition was particularly impressive.
sents.exz: 你在这次比赛中取得的成功尤其令人钦佩。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 讲事情补充
sents.en: This support included 帮助一 and 帮助二, reflecting your 品质一 and 品质二.
sents.zh: 这些帮助包括……和……，体现了您的……和……
sents.meta: 帮助备选: detailed guidance / useful advice / warm encouragement / thoughtful arrangements; 品质备选: kindness / patience / responsibility / generosity
sents.ex: This support included detailed guidance and warm encouragement, reflecting your kindness and patience.
sents.exz: 这种支持包括详细的指导和热情的鼓励，体现了您的善良和耐心。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 讲事情补充
sents.en: It has also enabled me to 直接收获 and given me the confidence to 进一步行动.
sents.zh: 这也使我能够……，并给了我……的信心去……。（感谢信版）
sents.meta: 感谢信收获: complete the task successfully / solve the problem / adapt to the new environment; 祝贺信收获: gain greater confidence / receive wider recognition / make further progress；祝贺信版: enabled you to + given you the opportunity to
sents.ex: It has also enabled me to complete the task successfully and given me the confidence to face similar challenges in the future.
sents.exz: 这也使我顺利完成了任务，并给了我面对未来类似挑战的信心。（感谢信版）

sents.en: I strongly recommend 推荐对象 as 具体选择或用途.
sents.zh: 我强烈推荐……作为/用于……
sents.meta: strongly recommend 可替换 highly recommend / would recommend / suggest choosing; 选择备选 an ideal choice / a suitable option / your first destination / a valuable resource
sents.ex: I strongly recommend the Palace Museum as your first destination in Beijing.
sents.exz: 我强烈推荐你将故宫作为北京之行的第一站。

sents.en: One major reason is that 理由.
sents.zh: 一个主要原因是……
sents.meta: one major reason 可替换 the primary reason / a key reason / what makes it particularly attractive; 万能理由: it offers an excellent opportunity to / it has rich historical and cultural value / it has great educational value / it offers considerable practical value
sents.ex: One major reason is that it offers an excellent opportunity to learn about Chinese history and traditional architecture.
sents.exz: 一个主要原因是，它提供了了解中国历史和传统建筑的绝佳机会。

sents.en: More importantly, these qualities will enable him/her to 工作结果.
sents.zh: 更重要的是，这些品质将使他/她能够……
sents.meta: 工作结果备选: perform the duties effectively / cooperate effectively with others / deal with unexpected problems / adapt quickly to the new environment / make a valuable contribution to the team
sents.ex: More importantly, these qualities will enable him to perform the duties effectively.
sents.exz: 更重要的是，这些品质将使他能够高效履行职责。

sents.en: More importantly, this feature allows visitors to 实际收获.
sents.zh: 更重要的是，这一特点能够让游客/读者……
sents.meta: this feature 可替换 this advantage / its rich content / its unique design; 收获备选: gain a deeper understanding of / broaden their horizons / enjoy a memorable cultural experience / apply the ideas to their daily lives；推荐书籍/电影/课程时 visitors 换 readers
sents.ex: More importantly, its grand ancient walls and beautiful mountain views allow visitors to enjoy amazing scenery and learn interesting historical stories.
sents.exz: 更重要的是，宏伟的古墙和优美的山景让游客能够欣赏到壮丽的风景，并了解有趣的历史故事。（2020英语二）

sents.grp: 第二段 · 解决问题类
sents.en: Unfortunately, 具体问题.
sents.zh: 很遗憾，……
sents.meta: Unfortunately 可替换 Regrettably / I am sorry to say that / I regret to inform you that; 问题备选: I will be unable to attend... / I cannot complete the task on time / the product failed to work properly / the service did not meet my expectations
sents.ex: Unfortunately, I will be unable to attend the meeting as originally planned.
sents.exz: 很遗憾，我无法按原计划参加会议。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 解决问题类
sents.en: This is mainly because 原因.
sents.zh: 这主要是因为……
sents.meta: 可替换 is due to the fact that / results from +名词 / has been caused by; 原因备选: I have to attend an important examination / an unexpected emergency has arisen / I have fallen ill / there has been a change in my schedule
sents.ex: This is mainly because I have to attend an important examination at the same time.
sents.exz: 这主要是因为我必须在同一时间参加一场重要考试。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 解决问题类
sents.en: As a result, 问题造成的影响.
sents.zh: 因此，……
sents.meta: 影响备选: I was unable to use the product / the problem caused considerable inconvenience / my work was seriously affected / additional time and money were wasted
sents.ex: As a result, I was unable to complete my work and suffered considerable inconvenience.
sents.exz: 因此，我无法完成工作，并遭受了很大不便。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 解决问题类
sents.en: To make up for 问题, I will 补救办法.
sents.zh: 为了弥补……，我将……
sents.meta: To make up for 可替换 To compensate for; 补救备选: arrange another meeting / complete the task as soon as possible / ask a classmate to take notes
sents.ex: To make up for my absence, I will ask a classmate to take notes and send me the relevant materials.
sents.exz: 为了弥补缺席，我会请一位同学做记录，并把相关材料发给我。

sents.grp: 第二段 · 解决问题类
sents.en: To resolve the matter, I would appreciate it if you could 解决办法.
sents.zh: 为了解决此事，如果您能……，我将不胜感激。
sents.meta: To resolve the matter 可替换 To address the problem / To deal with the issue; 办法备选: provide a replacement / offer a full refund / take appropriate measures / investigate the matter
sents.ex: To resolve the matter, I would appreciate it if you could provide a replacement or offer a full refund.
sents.exz: 为了解决此事，如果您能更换产品或全额退款，我将不胜感激。

sents.en: I sincerely hope that you will 动作 my 事项.
sents.zh: 我真诚地希望您能……我的……
sents.meta: 动作×事项搭配: accept invitation/apology 接受邀请/道歉 / consider suggestions 考虑建议 / adopt suggestions 采纳建议 / approve application 批准申请 / understand decision 理解决定 / respect decision 尊重决定；sincerely 可替换 truly / genuinely
sents.ex: I sincerely hope that you will understand and respect my decision.
sents.exz: 我真诚地希望您能够理解并尊重我的决定。

sents.en: A reply at your earliest convenience would be highly appreciated.
sents.zh: 如能在您方便时尽早回复，我将十分感谢。

sents.en: Please let me know your decision at your earliest convenience.
sents.zh: 请您方便时尽早告知我您的决定。

sents.en: Please let me know 回复内容 when convenient.
sents.zh: 请在方便时告诉我……
sents.meta: 回复内容备选: your thoughts / your opinion / your plans / whether you can attend / whether the arrangement suits you; when convenient 可替换 when you have time / at your convenience / as soon as possible
sents.ex: Please let me know your thoughts when convenient.
sents.exz: 方便时请告诉我你的想法。（2011英语一）

sents.en: The Students' Union is pleased to announce that 活动名称 will be held.
sents.zh: 学生会很高兴地宣布……将举办。
sents.meta: 活动名称备选: reading sharing session 读书分享会 / English speech contest / essay competition / campus cultural festival / art exhibition / campus food festival / volunteer recruitment
sents.ex: The Students' Union is pleased to announce that a campus book fair will be held.
sents.exz: 学生会很高兴地宣布，将举办校园书展。

sents.en: It's a pleasure to inform everyone that a 活动名称 will be held in our university.
sents.zh: 很高兴地通知大家，我校将举办……活动。
sents.ex: It's a pleasure to inform everyone that an English speech contest will be held in our university.
sents.exz: 很高兴地通知大家，我校将举办英语演讲比赛。

sents.en: The purpose of the event is to 活动目的.
sents.zh: 本次活动的目的是……
sents.meta: 目的备选: promote cultural exchange / enrich campus life / raise environmental awareness / improve practical skills / encourage communication / provide learning opportunities / help students learn more about...
sents.ex: The purpose of the event is to encourage students to develop an interest in reading.
sents.exz: 本次活动旨在鼓励学生培养阅读兴趣。

sents.en: The purpose of this notice is to provide 对象 with details about 事项.
sents.zh: 本通知旨在向……提供有关……的详细信息。
sents.meta: with details about 可替换 with information regarding / with relevant information on
sents.ex: The purpose of this notice is to provide all students with details about the upcoming book fair.
sents.exz: 本通知旨在向全体学生介绍即将举行的书展的具体信息。

sents.grp: 通知 · 活动通知第二段
sents.en: The event will be held in 地点 at 时间 on 日期.
sents.zh: 该活动将于……在……举行。
sents.meta: 搭配: at+具体时刻 at 2:00 p.m. / on+具体日期 on May 10 / in+室内场所 in the school auditorium / at+具体地点 at the school gate; event 可替换 activity / lecture / competition / workshop；at 用于具体地点(at the school gate), in 用于室内场所
sents.ex: The event will be held in the school auditorium from 2:00 to 4:00 p.m. on May 10.
sents.exz: 该活动将于5月10日下午2点至4点在学校礼堂举行。

sents.grp: 通知 · 活动通知第二段
sents.en: All students interested in 主题 are welcome to attend.
sents.zh: 欢迎所有对……感兴趣的学生参加。
sents.meta: are welcome to attend 可替换 are encouraged to participate / may attend / can participate
sents.ex: All students interested in traditional Chinese culture are welcome to attend.
sents.exz: 欢迎所有喜爱中国传统文化的同学到场参与。

sents.grp: 通知 · 活动通知第二段
sents.en: Highlights will include 活动1, 活动2 and 活动3.
sents.zh: 本次活动亮点包括……
sents.ex: Highlights will include a keynote speech, a group discussion and a question-and-answer session.
sents.exz: 本次活动亮点设有主旨演讲、小组讨论以及问答环节。

sents.grp: 通知 · 招募通知第二段
sents.en: Ideal applicants should be 品质 and possess 能力.
sents.zh: 理想的申请者应当……并具备……
sents.meta: 品质(形容词): responsible / patient / reliable / enthusiastic / hard-working / cooperative / energetic; 能力(名词短语): good communication skills / strong organizational skills / excellent teamwork skills / a good command of English
sents.ex: Ideal applicants should be responsible and possess good communication skills.
sents.exz: 理想人选需有责任心，并且具备良好的沟通能力。

sents.grp: 通知 · 招募通知第二段
sents.en: We are looking for applicants who are 品质 and have 能力.
sents.zh: 我们寻找的申请者需拥有……品质，掌握……能力。
sents.ex: We are looking for applicants who are patient and have good communication skills.
sents.exz: 我们寻找的申请者需富有耐心，并且掌握良好的沟通能力。

sents.grp: 通知 · 招募通知第二段
sents.en: Previous volunteer experience will be considered an advantage.
sents.zh: 具有志愿服务经验将被视为一项优势。
sents.meta: volunteer experience 可替换 relevant experience / working experience / similar experience / social practice experience / event-organizing experience

sents.grp: 通知 · 招募通知第二段
sents.en: Candidates with good cross-cultural awareness will be preferred.
sents.zh: 具备良好跨文化意识的候选人将优先录用。
sents.meta: cross-cultural awareness 可替换 strong organizational skills / effective teamwork spirit / time-management ability / problem-solving skills / fluent oral English / public speaking ability

sents.grp: 通知 · 招募通知第二段
sents.en: The main duties involve 动名词1, 动名词2 and 动名词3.
sents.zh: 主要工作包括……
sents.meta: 职责备选: receiving guests / answering inquiries / offering directions / preparing materials / maintaining order / providing language assistance / taking photos / distributing leaflets
sents.ex: The main duties involve receiving guests, offering directions and preparing conference materials.
sents.exz: 主要工作职责包括接待来宾、指引方向以及准备会议资料。

sents.en: Those who are interested should 报名方式 through 渠道 by 截止时间.
sents.zh: 感兴趣的同学应于……前通过……报名。
sents.meta: 方式备选: register for the event / sign up for the activity / submit an application / send a brief self-introduction; 渠道备选: through the school website / through the online system / at the Students' Union office
sents.ex: Those who are interested should register for the event through the school website by May 10.
sents.exz: 感兴趣的同学应于5月10日前通过学校网站报名参加本次活动。

sents.en: Interested applicants are expected to submit 材料 via 渠道 before the deadline.
sents.zh: 有意申请者需在截止日期前通过指定平台提交申请材料。
sents.meta: 材料备选: a brief self-introduction / application form / resume / personal statement

sents.en: For further information, please contact 联系人 at 联系方式.
sents.zh: 如需了解更多信息，请通过……联系……
sents.meta: For further information 可替换 For more details / If you have any questions
sents.ex: For further information, please contact the Students' Union at studentsunion@university.edu.
sents.exz: 如需了解更多信息，请通过 studentsunion@university.edu 联系学生会。

sents.en: Should you have any questions, feel free to reach out to 联系人/组织 via 联系方式.
sents.zh: 如您有任何疑问，可通过……联系……

sents.en: The 图表类型 above clearly shows 主题内容 in 地点 时间.
sents.zh: 上述……清楚地展示了……。
sents.meta: 图表类型: bar chart 柱状图 / pie chart 饼状图 / line graph 折线图 / table 表格; 动词: show the changes in... / show the percentage of... / show the differences between... / compare... in terms of...；compares 用于多类对比(如饼图各因素)
sents.ex: The pie charts above clearly show the factors that students considered when choosing a university in China in two different years.
sents.exz: 上述饼状图清楚地展示了近两年中国学生选择大学时所考虑的因素。

sents.en: What the 图表类型 provided is the purpose of 主题.
sents.zh: ……提供了……的调查结果。
sents.meta: purpose 可替换 reasons / choices / elements
sents.ex: What the pie chart provided is the purpose of mobile reading for students in a certain university.
sents.exz: 该饼状图提供了某高校学生手机阅读目的的调查结果。

sents.en: According to the above 图表类型, the percentages of 对象 in 范围 underwent an enormous change 时间.
sents.zh: 根据上面……所示，……的百分比在……年间发生了巨大的变化。
sents.ex: According to the above bar chart, the percentages of graduates' choices after graduation in a certain university underwent an enormous change from 2013 to 2018.
sents.exz: 根据上面柱状图所示，某高校毕业生去向的百分比在2013至2018年间发生了巨大的变化。

sents.en: There was a noticeable increase in 对象词 from A to B 时间.
sents.zh: 在……时间内，……出现了显著的增长（从A到B）。
sents.meta: 升降名词: increase/rise/growth/drop/decline/fall; 程度词: noticeable/remarkable/dramatic; 副词库见素材: dramatically/sharply/considerably/rapidly/steadily/gradually/slightly；increase 可替换 rise / growth;下降用 decline / drop
sents.ex: There was a remarkable increase in the health literacy level among Chinese residents, from 8.80% in 2012 to 25.40% in 2021.
sents.exz: 2012年至2021年，我国居民健康素养水平显著提高，从8.80%升至25.40%。（2023英语二真题数据）

sents.en: 对象词 increased 数字 时间.
sents.zh: ……（对象）在……（时间）增长到……。
sents.meta: 词组备选: continue its upward trend / on the rise / on the decline / remain stable 保持平稳 / fluctuate between...and... 波动
sents.ex: The volume of goods transported by rail increased to 40 million tons in 2002, and then it stood at this level in the rest of the period.
sents.exz: 铁路运输货物的数量2002年增加到了4000万吨，之后就一直保持这一水平。

sents.en: During this period, the percentage of 对象A has increased sharply from A to B, whereas those doing sth increased markedly from A1 and A2 to B1 and B2 respectively.
sents.zh: 在此期间，……的数量从A急剧增长至B；而……分别从A1、A2显著增长到B1、B2。
sents.meta: 下降方向: has declined sharply / declined markedly
sents.ex: During this period, the percentage of students choosing further education has increased sharply from 26.3% to 34%, whereas those running their own business increased markedly from 1.3% to 2.6%.
sents.exz: 在此期间，选择升学的学生比例从26.3%急剧上升到34%，而自主创业的学生比例也从1.3%显著增长到2.6%。（2019英语二真题数据）

sents.en: The proportion of A is higher than B, while 补充对比.
sents.zh: A的占比高于B，而……。
sents.meta: is higher than 可替换 is the same as / is equal to 与…持平；下降用 is lower than;持平 is the same as
sents.ex: The proportion of spending on New Year gifts is higher than that on dinners, transportation and other items, whereas the percentages of the latter three categories are equal to one another.
sents.exz: 新年礼物的花销占比高于聚餐、交通以及其他项目，而后三者的占比持平。（2015英语二）

sents.en: The percentage of A, compared with B, 数据描述.
sents.zh: A的数据，相较于B的数据……。
sents.meta: compared with 可替换 compared to / in contrast to
sents.ex: The percentage of males choosing computer science stands at 10%, compared with 4% of females.
sents.exz: 选择计算机专业的男生占10%，相比之下女生仅占4%。

sents.en: The figure of A is similar to / the same as B.
sents.zh: A的数据和B组相近/持平。

sents.en: There was a huge gap between A and B: 数据.
sents.zh: A与B之间存在巨大差距。
sents.meta: a huge gap 可替换 a big difference / a huge change
sents.ex: There was a huge gap between the proportions of males and females choosing medicine: about 4% for males and 15% for females.
sents.exz: 选择医学专业的男女比例存在巨大差距：男生约4%，女生约15%。

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to several factors.
sents.zh: 这种现象可以归因于几个因素。
sents.meta: 可替换 can be traced to / is caused by

sents.en: Several factors can account for this trend.
sents.zh: 有几个因素能解释这一趋势。
sents.meta: 另备: The reasons behind this phenomenon are not difficult to identify. 这一现象背后的原因不难发现；trend 可替换 phenomenon
sents.ex: Several factors can account for this trend. First, the development of the economy has provided local governments with more financial resources.
sents.exz: 有几个因素可以解释这一趋势。首先，经济发展为地方政府提供了更多资金。（英一2024城市公园真题套用）

sents.en: First, the growing popularity of 原因 has offered people more opportunities to 机会做的事, enabling them to 行为.
sents.zh: 首先，【原因】的日益流行给人们提供了更多机会去做【机会做的事】，使他们能够【行为】。
sents.meta: 10-31用户拍板为主选。原因槽=能流行的事物(online shopping网购/fitness apps健身App/short videos短视频)；机会做的事=动词短语，to后不接名词(buy whatever they like)；行为=照抄图注口径，与yy-2系行为槽错开。经济/政策类原因popularity装不下，换用yy-1(development of)。约22词。
sents.ex: First, the growing popularity of national fitness has offered people more opportunities to exercise at any time, enabling them to take regular exercise.
sents.exz: 2021英语二健身：首先，全民健身的日益流行给人们提供了更多随时锻炼的机会，使他们能够定期锻炼。

sents.slot: 个人观念原因句·全龄版
sents.en: Besides, with the growing awareness of 主题, people from different age groups are more likely to 行为.
sents.zh: 此外，随着对【主题】意识的增强，不同年龄段的人更有可能【行为】。
sents.meta: yy-2的全龄版(10-31用户拍板为主选)。age groups只配全民类话题(健身/手机/消费)；学生/农村/老人类图换回yy-2(an increasing number of people)。行为槽与yy-1系错开。
sents.ex: Besides, with the growing awareness of health, people from different age groups are more likely to do sports in their daily lives.
sents.exz: 此外，随着健康意识的增强，不同年龄段的人更有可能在日常生活中运动。（接yy-1b后使用）

sents.en: First, the development of 宏观原因 has provided people with 条件, making it easier for them to 行为.
sents.zh: 首先，……的发展为人们提供了……，使他们更容易……
sents.meta: development of 可替换 improvement of / continued growth of / widespread application of / growing popularity of / increasing availability of
sents.ex: First, the rapid development of technology has provided people with more convenient services, making it easier for them to obtain information.
sents.exz: 首先，科技的快速发展为人们提供了更加便利的服务，使他们更容易获取信息。

sents.en: Besides, with the growing awareness of 主题, an increasing number of people are willing to 行为.
sents.zh: 此外，随着人们对……的意识不断增强，越来越多的人愿意……。
sents.meta: growing awareness of 可替换 increasing attention paid to / rising demand for / changing attitudes toward / people attaching greater importance to
sents.ex: Besides, with the growing awareness of environmental protection, an increasing number of people are willing to adopt a greener lifestyle.
sents.exz: 此外，随着环保意识不断增强，越来越多的人愿意选择更加环保的生活方式。

sents.en: Rising incomes have enabled more people to 行为.
sents.zh: 收入的增长使更多人能够……

sents.en: The rapid development of technology has made it easier for people to 行为.
sents.zh: 科技的快速发展使人们更容易……

sents.en: Supportive policies have created favorable conditions for 主题.
sents.zh: 支持性政策为……创造了有利条件。

sents.en: Changing attitudes toward 主题 have made people more willing to 行为.
sents.zh: 对……的态度变化使人们更愿意……

sents.en: Many people lack sufficient awareness of the importance of 主题.
sents.zh: 许多人没有充分意识到……的重要性。

sents.en: The lack of effective supervision has allowed the problem to become increasingly serious.
sents.zh: 有效监管的缺失使这一问题日益严重。

sents.en: As a result, this phenomenon can not only 个人影响 but also 社会影响.
sents.zh: 因此，这一现象不仅能够……，还能够……（正负面都可以）
sents.meta: 例: weaken individuals' ability to think independently + increase society's dependence on technology; help individuals make better health decisions + reduce pressure on the healthcare system
sents.ex: As a result, this phenomenon can not only weaken individuals' ability to think independently but also increase society's dependence on technology.
sents.exz: 因此，这一现象不仅可能削弱个人独立思考的能力，还可能加深社会对技术的依赖。

sents.en: This trend can improve 个人积极结果 and promote 社会积极结果.
sents.zh: 这一趋势能够改善……，并促进……
sents.meta: improve 可替换 enhance; promote 可替换 support
sents.ex: This trend can improve individuals' quality of life and promote public health.
sents.exz: 这一趋势能够改善个人生活质量，并促进公共健康。

sents.en: This problem may harm 个人受损对象 and increase 社会负担.
sents.zh: 这一问题可能损害……，并增加……
sents.meta: harm 可替换 damage; increase 可替换 add to
sents.ex: This phenomenon may harm individuals' health and increase pressure on the healthcare system.
sents.exz: 这一现象可能损害个人健康，并增加医疗体系的压力。

sents.en: Overall, this change reflects social progress and people's pursuit of a better life.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这一变化反映了社会进步和人们对美好生活的追求。

sents.en: If left unaddressed, this problem may produce more serious consequences in the future.
sents.zh: 如果得不到解决，这一问题将来可能造成更加严重的后果。

sents.en: Overall, this phenomenon is the result of both social development and changing individual needs.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这一现象是社会发展与个人需求变化共同作用的结果。

sents.en: Therefore, the change shown in the chart is not accidental but the result of several interconnected factors.
sents.zh: 因此，图表所显示的变化并非偶然，而是多种相互关联因素共同作用的结果。

sents.en: In conclusion, 主题词 is essential for both individuals and society.
sents.zh: 总之，……对个人和社会都是必不可少的。
sents.meta: In conclusion 可替换 To sum up / In summary / Overall; is essential for 可替换 is of great importance to / plays a key role in / is vital for
sents.ex: In conclusion, the awareness of environmental protection is essential for both individuals and society.
sents.exz: 总之，环保意识对个人和社会都至关重要。

sents.en: Overall, 主题词 plays a vital role in promoting personal growth and social progress.
sents.zh: 总体而言，……在促进个人成长和社会进步方面发挥着重要作用。
sents.meta: promotes 可替换 encourages / facilitates / contributes to
sents.ex: Overall, perseverance plays a vital role in promoting personal growth and social progress.
sents.exz: 总体而言，坚持在促进个人成长和社会进步方面发挥着重要作用。

sents.en: In conclusion, this issue deserves more attention from the public.
sents.zh: 总之，这个问题值得公众更多的关注。
sents.meta: deserves more attention 可替换 calls for greater concern / requires immediate attention 亟待重视

sents.en: To sum up, effective measures should be taken to prevent this problem from becoming more serious.
sents.zh: 总之，应当采取有效措施，防止这一问题变得更加严重。
sents.meta: effective measures 可替换 practical measures / concrete action / joint efforts; becoming more serious 可替换 growing worse / continuing to spread

sents.en: In conclusion, this trend is likely to continue in the coming years.
sents.zh: 总之，这一趋势很可能在未来几年继续下去。
sents.meta: is likely to 可替换 is expected to / will probably / may well

sents.en: With the continued development of 相关因素, an increasing number of people are likely to 行为.
sents.zh: 随着……的持续发展，越来越多的人可能会……
sents.meta: in the coming years 可替换 in the years ahead / in the near future / in the foreseeable future

sents.en: Therefore, we should develop 主题品质 in our daily lives. In this way, we can improve ourselves and achieve our goals.
sents.zh: 因此，我们应当在日常生活中培养……。这样，我们就能提升自我并实现目标。
sents.meta: develop 可替换 cultivate 培养 / practice 践行; improve ourselves 可替换 make progress / develop our abilities; achieve our goals 可替换 realize our dreams / achieve success
sents.ex: Therefore, we should develop perseverance in our daily lives. In this way, we can better overcome difficulties and achieve our goals.
sents.exz: 因此，我们应当在日常生活中培养坚持的品质。这样，我们就能更好地克服困难、实现目标。

sents.en: It is therefore necessary for us to translate our recognition of 主题 into concrete action. Only by integrating it into our daily practice can we achieve personal growth and contribute to social progress.
sents.zh: 因此，我们有必要将对……的认同转化为具体行动。只有将其融入日常实践，我们才能实现个人成长并推动社会进步。
sents.meta: integrate it into 可替换 apply it to / incorporate it into

sents.en: Therefore, we should take effective measures to address this problem. In this way, we can reduce its harmful effects and prevent it from worsening.
sents.zh: 因此，我们应当采取有效措施解决这一问题。这样，我们就能减少其危害，并防止问题进一步恶化。
sents.meta: take effective measures 可替换 take action / adopt proper measures; address this problem 可替换 solve this problem / deal with this issue

sents.en: To address this problem, individuals should 个人措施, while schools / the government should 社会措施. These efforts can help reduce its negative effects and create a healthier social environment.
sents.zh: 为了解决这一问题，个人应当……，而学校/政府应当……。这些努力有助于减少其负面影响，并营造更加健康的社会环境。
sents.meta: 个人措施: control their behavior / develop good habits / raise their awareness / exercise greater self-discipline; 社会措施: offer more support / strengthen public education / provide proper guidance / improve relevant regulations

sents.en: Joint efforts should be made by individuals and relevant authorities to address the root causes of this problem. Only through coordinated action can we prevent it from causing further damage and bring about lasting improvement.
sents.zh: 个人和有关部门应当共同努力，从根源上解决这一问题。只有通过协调一致的行动，我们才能防止它造成进一步损害，并实现持久改善。
sents.meta: relevant authorities 可替换 schools / communities / the government; address the root causes 可替换 tackle the problem at its source

sents.en: Therefore, we should view this phenomenon rationally and make proper use of it. In this way, 主题 can bring more benefits to 对象 while minimizing potential harm.
sents.zh: 因此，我们应当理性看待这一现象，并对其加以合理利用。这样，……就能为……带来更多益处，同时尽可能减少潜在危害。
sents.meta: make proper use of it 可替换 use it wisely / deal with it properly; bring more benefits 可替换 play a positive role / create greater value
sents.ex: Therefore, we should view this phenomenon rationally and make proper use of it. In this way, AI can bring more benefits to individuals while minimizing potential harm.
sents.exz: 因此，我们应当理性看待这一现象并加以合理利用。这样，人工智能就能为个人带来更多益处，同时尽可能减少潜在危害。

sents.en: Therefore, we should make full use of its advantages while keeping its possible risks under control. With proper guidance, it can develop in a healthier and more sustainable direction.
sents.zh: 因此，我们应当充分发挥其优势，同时控制可能存在的风险。通过合理引导，它能够朝着更加健康、可持续的方向发展。
sents.meta: make full use of 可替换 take advantage of / bring...into full play; possible risks 可替换 potential problems / negative effects / limitations

sents.en: Rather than accepting or rejecting this trend blindly, we should evaluate it objectively and establish reasonable boundaries for its development. Only when its benefits are maximized and its risks minimized can it truly serve the long-term interests of individuals and society.
sents.zh: 我们不应盲目接受或排斥这一趋势，而应客观评价，并为其发展设定合理边界。只有充分发挥其优势并尽量降低风险，它才能真正服务于个人和社会的长远利益。
sents.meta: evaluate it objectively 可替换 view it from a balanced perspective / assess it rationally

sents.grp: 第二段 · 品质价值(拓展)
sents.en: For one thing, it enables us to 正向价值1.
sents.zh: 一方面，它使我们能够……
sents.meta: enables 可替换 allows / makes it possible for; 品质×价值搭配: perseverance 坚持→overcome difficulties and keep moving forward / innovation 创新→break free from conventional thinking / responsibility 责任感→fulfill our duties and deal with problems actively

sents.grp: 第二段 · 品质价值(拓展)
sents.en: For another, it helps us 正向价值2.
sents.zh: 另一方面，它帮助我们……
sents.meta: helps 可替换 encourages / motivates
